name: 阵亡者护甲 Armor of the Fallen (BMT)

description.value:
护甲（中甲或重甲），非普通（需同调）

穿着这套护甲期间，你可以用其施展法术@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.o9GQEt4fYw6WjpB0]{死者交谈 Speak with Dead}或是@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.xYpJGRI4xcMa41kO]{活化死尸 Animate Dead}。以此施展了法术后，直到次日黎明为止这套护甲都无法再次被用于施展这两个法术。

这套盔甲会随着你灵魂的离去而消逝。若你在同调这套护甲期间死亡，这套护甲也将随之摧毁。

While wearing this armor, you can use it to cast either @spell[Speak with Dead] or @spell[Animate Dead]. Once the armor has cast a spell in this way, it can't cast either spell until the next dawn.

Your soul keeps this armor together. If you die while you are attuned to the armor, the armor is destroyed.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Breastplate|PHB] (@item[Breastplate of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Mail|PHB] (@item[Chain Mail of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Shirt|PHB] (@item[Chain Shirt of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Half Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Half Plate Armor of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Hide Armor|PHB] (@item[Hide Armor of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Plate Armor of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Ring Mail|PHB] (@item[Ring Mail of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Scale Mail|PHB] (@item[Scale Mail of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Spiked Armor|SCAG] (@item[Spiked Armor of the Fallen|BMT])
  • @item[Splint Armor|PHB] (@item[Splint Armor of the Fallen|BMT])
